verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law-firm and software platform. A SaaS platform of this kind could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a web client portal, with no CLI mentioned. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so nothing suggests any developer or command-line surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
